description: Defines an abstract class LegendRenderer responsible for rendering and formatting chart legends in PDFsharp library, including layout calculations and drawing logic.

classes.name: LegendRenderer
classes.description: Abstract class for rendering chart legends, handling layout and drawing, with constants for padding and border line width.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout dimensions for the legend, including size, spacing, and padding.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the legend and its border on the graphics context.
